## Frequently Asked Questions


### How can a fashion brand make $1,000 a month on TikTok Shop?


A fashion brand can reach $1,000 a month on TikTok Shop by recruiting creators who generate consistent apparel sales and tracking net revenue after commissions, returns, and sample costs. Reacher helps brands find creators using creator and GMV data, then supports outreach, sample workflows, and re-engagement for creators who stop responding.


### How should a clothing brand promote its products on TikTok?


A clothing brand should promote products on TikTok through a mix of creator outreach, product-focused briefs, affiliate commissions, and consistent short-form content. Reacher supports custom workflows, brand-voice replies to inbound creator messages, and creator re-engagement automation so fashion teams can manage outreach at scale.


### How can I find TikTok Shop products to promote as a creator?


Creators can find TikTok Shop products to promote by reviewing category fit, recent sales activity, commission terms, customer demand, and content performance. TikTok Shop creators should favor apparel products with clear sizing information, reliable fulfillment, and brands that provide responsive support and useful content guidance.


### How should I pick products for a TikTok creator shop?


A TikTok creator should pick products with strong category fit, clear customer demand, attractive commission terms, and a low risk of returns. Fashion creators should also review size and color options, product quality, shipping reliability, and whether the brand can provide accurate product details for content.


### How many views do you need on TikTok to make $100?


TikTok views do not guarantee $100, because earnings depend on product conversion, commission, order value, and returns rather than reach alone. A smaller creator with steady apparel sales can outperform a larger account with more views, so brands should review creator-specific orders, revenue per video, and recent GMV.
